headline: Travel + Leisure (TNL) Stock Fair Value Edges Higher After Analyst Target Increases
summary: Travel + Leisure now carries a refreshed fair value estimate of US$91.00 per share, up from US$87.08, as analysts adjust their views on the stock. Recent research, including price targets that span roughly US$77 to US$107 and an upgrade to Buy from Goldman Sachs with an US$85 target, shows how opinions are shifting as new earnings and acquisition details come through. headline: Arcus Biosciences (RCUS) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Casdatifan Optimism
summary: The fair value estimate for Arcus Biosciences has shifted from US$35.75 to US$38.00, signaling a modest reset in where analysts think the stock could reasonably trade. That move tracks with recent updates that balance enthusiasm around the kidney cancer franchise, especially casdatifan, against questions about how quickly those programs can translate into durable commercial performance.
